title: The One Who Lurks
paragraphs: Then, it’s time to take action.
“So, Yuki-chan, let’s check out the forest and then head back to the village.”
“Understood! I’ll go search now!”

Father and my sister’s sister went toward the cave, while Yuki-chan and I went to the forest to look for anything edible. At first glance, the forest didn’t seem too deep. I could see the other side through the gaps between the trees.
“Is there anything edible here?”
With that thought, I looked up together with Yuki-chan. At that moment, I heard a rustling sound from the bushes.
Was something hiding there?
“Is it a monster?”
Just as I was about to ready my spear, something emerged from the bushes as if fleeing.

What is that? A weasel, composed of something that looked like a pale blue shimmer or heat haze? It might be a ghost-type monster. I immediately changed my weapon to the Soul Eater Spear. However, the pale blue weasel didn’t seem to react. The monster stopped briefly and glanced back at us. Then, the weasel changed its form. In an instant, it took on the appearance of a tanuki. It’s a little bigger than usual.
…? This one has a physical form. I feel like I can see a shadow of a person within the haze.

Is it different from a ghost-type monster? As I considered whether to chase after it and take it down, the tanuki had already turned its back and started running. And as it moved, it multiplied into several more along with the heat haze.
If it’s a monster, I should just annihilate it!
“Aiming—”
But before I could throw my spear, the weasels, which had transformed further as they ran, all leapt into the sea and disappeared completely.
“What was that?”

Chasing after fleeing prey was one option, but they didn’t look like suitable food, so ignoring them seemed fine. If they appeared again, I could just take them down then. I resumed searching for any edible fruit in the forest and then went with Yuki-chan to fetch Filolial-sama and the slaves. After that, the monster didn’t appear again. The slaves and Filolial-samas enjoyed a swim at my sister’s sister’s hidden island before returning to the castle. The next day, around noon. A slightly tired-looking assistant returned, accompanied by Ren and my rival.
“We’re back.”
“Welcome back.”
During a break in the search for Filo-tan, Father and I greeted them.
“How did it go?”
“Yeah, dad was really strong. I thought I’d gotten pretty strong myself, but I still don’t think I can beat him. But… why does he have power similar to Gaelion?”
“Na… no!”
My rival was crying out as if worried about the assistant.
No matter how I looked at it, didn’t the assistant just win by using my rival’s abilities?
“Isn’t it normal for a parent and child to be similar?”
“Hmm… I was able to beat the dad in my memories, though…”

That is undoubtedly true. After all, he’s only strong enough to lose to Ren, whose enhancement methods are half-baked. He doesn’t even come close to rival’s level now. Moreover, the assistant has leveled up quite a bit, so it should have been an easy win. The fact that he still couldn’t win makes it clear that he was definitely borrowing rival’s power.
“Memory and reality are different things. Something that looks easy can be difficult when you actually try it.”
“Yeah. Dad was really strong after all. The Sword Hero said the same thing.”

The assistant nodded there. It’s probably not just my imagination that he looks proud of having such a strong father. However, the assistant slightly lowered his head so that his bangs cast a shadow over his eyes and grinned.
“When I get even stronger, I’ll challenge him again. Next time, I’ll surpass Dad.”
Fufufufufu… he’s giving an unsettling grin. On the other hand, rival looks like he’s trembling at that sight. Father and Ren looked at the assistant and rival with a somewhat exasperated expression.
“Good work, Ren.”
“Ah, it’s no big deal. I’m just leveling up, studying, and training to prepare for the waves anyway. It was a good change of pace.”
“That’s good to hear.”
“How’s it going on your end?”
“Hm? Ah… we haven’t found anything yet. But I don’t plan to give up.”
“No, that’s not what I meant.”
Ren glanced back and forth between Father and me.
“We haven’t found Filo-tan’s egg.”
“Ah, yeah, I know about Motoyasu. I also asked Naofumi. But Naofumi, how’s Sadina doing?”
Father was about to open his mouth to respond, with a slight cough.
“Oh my, Windia-chan, are you back?”
My sister’s sister came over with the slaves.
“Welcome back, Ren-chan.”
“Ah, yeah.”
Ren pointed at my sister’s sister and then looked at Father. Father nodded.
“Her cold has gotten better, and Sadina is back to full strength.”
“I see. That’s good to hear.”
“Yeah.”
“Well, I should get back to work. I’ll be heading on an expedition to the Northfera Great Forest soon.”
Ren said while stretching.
“I need to make preparations. I’ll also be strengthening the forces to prepare for the Four Guardian Beasts and the waves.”
“Yeah, we need to get ready in advance… You’ll be raising the Filolials too, right?”
“It’s for Motoyasu, after all.”
“I’ve secured Luna-chan’s egg!”
Father said he wanted to redo the experiment. Ah, I’ll get to reunite with that adorable Luna-chan. But unfortunately, Keel isn’t here, is he? Would a mole be an acceptable substitute?
“Nano?”
At that moment, rival sniffed the air and transformed into his dragon form. Then, as if tracing the scent, he followed Father and then my sister’s sister.
“Na…nano…?”
“Oh? What’s wrong?”
My sister’s sister sat down to meet rival’s gaze and extended her hand to pet him. However, rival ignored her hand and kept sniffing. Eventually, rival’s eyes widened…
“Nanooooooooooooooooooooooooooo!”
He placed both hands on his cheeks and screamed. It was like a pose straight out of a painting.
“Gaelion…wants to loop…nano…”
Then he collapsed.
“Gaelion!?”
“Gaelion-chan!?”
“Wh-what happened?”
“What’s wrong?”
My sister’s sister lifted the collapsed rival, but he remained unconscious. What a strange dragon he is.
“For now, something might have happened to Gaelion-chan, so should we take him to Rat?”
“Got it! I’ll take him right away!”
Ren took rival and the assistant and teleported away using the portal.
“What…exactly happened?”
“Maybe the alcohol I was drinking was too strong? I had some really good stuff yesterday.”
“Gaelion-chan is a dragon, so he’s supposed to be strong against alcohol…”
“Did rival develop some strange disease? If so, serves him right.”
“Indeed.”
“Waaaah!”
The Filolials laughed together cheerfully. I’m starting to enjoy this too.
“Um…everyone, it’s not okay to laugh at someone being sick, you know?”

With Father’s glare, the Filolials stopped laughing. I suppose I should stop here too. By the way, rival regained consciousness the next day, and the doctor confirmed he wasn’t sick—on the contrary, he was in excellent health. They analyzed it as something psychological, but when they asked, he refused to talk. What could possibly be making him so emotionally unstable?
Chapter 747 – Romance

The day to head to the Nosferatu Great Forest was approaching. We had finished our preparations and planned to depart tomorrow. Before departure, we all gathered and soaked in the hot springs of Cal Mira Island. The panda, Fohl, and the others were here too. Tonight, we were staying on Cal Mira Island. It feels like it’s been a while with everything that’s happened.
“Phew…that was a good bath.”
“Indeed.”

After leaving the bath, Ren and Itsuki were cooling their flushed bodies with fans. Once again, I couldn’t do any peeping tonight. I drank a glass of milk after the bath. Speaking of which, what’s Itsuki doing about that stalker pig? Just as I was thinking that, the stalker pig came out of the women’s bath and sat next to Itsuki. Itsuki was fanning her to cool down her flushed body. She seemed to be in much better spirits, didn’t she?

Oh? The panda was also cooling off a bit further away after his bath. Yuki-chan was playing tag with Sakura-chan and Kou. They’re so energetic. Rival was still emotionally unstable and was resting with the assistant in their room.
“Tomorrow, we head to the Nosferatu Great Forest.”
“Do you think it’ll be like what happened on Cal Mira Island?”
“This time, there’s also the training of the slaves and soldiers from various countries, right?”
“Being a hero is tough.”
“But considering the battles that lie ahead, it’s something that must be done.”
“By the way, did you hear? They’re planning to have mock battles to improve coordination.”
“That sounds troublesome… but from what Naofumi said, it’s better to do it.”
At that moment, Father arrived with my sister’s sister. He had already gotten out of the bath earlier. Oh? What’s this? Father was holding hands with my sister’s sister, looking a little embarrassed.
“Um… I thought I should probably report this a little sooner…”
“Hm?”
“What’s going on?”

Is something happening? Father seemed to be exuding an unfamiliar air. Ren picked up the bottle of chilled milk, cooled it even more with magic, and took a sip. He seemed ready to listen to Father seriously.
“I… decided to start dating Sadina-san.”
Pfft! Ren spat out his drink spectacularly.
“Cough! Cough!”

Itsuki also stopped fanning and seemed utterly speechless. Oh, Father is dating my sister’s sister? Hm? I feel like the version of my sister in my memories just got upset. I seem to recall her scolding Father at times like this. No, wait… it feels like Father himself was getting annoyed in those memories…?
“You don’t have to be that surprised!”
“Cough! Cough! Think about the timing! You caught me off guard!”
“Oh my, I’m so sorry.”
“The timing was so perfect that I’m starting to think you did it on purpose.”
My sister’s sister gave a playful laugh. What a carefree attitude.

But… come to think of it, Father had been desperately trying to persuade my sister’s sister. It’s not an unreasonable conclusion. Even in the first world, I seem to recall hearing that my sister’s sister had feelings for Father.
“After surrounding yourself with so many little girls, you’re making Sadina your girlfriend now?”
“Surrounding myself with little girls…? It’s not like that. They’re just kids.”
“I see. Itsuki, so Naofumi is a lolicon, but it’s not like he’s thinking of them that way.”
“Well… and of all people, it’s Sadina, huh?”
“Oh my?”
“Aren’t you speaking poorly about Sadina?”
Itsuki shook his head.
“I didn’t mean it that way. I was just thinking… if he’s not a lolicon, I thought maybe he was into guys, but it turns out he prefers older women.”
“Ah, this outcome is surprising.”
“Hey… you two…”
Father gave Itsuki a half-lidded glare. Then, as if pondering, he placed his hand on his forehead.
“Well, it’s fine, isn’t it? The important thing is that Naofumi-chan likes your sister and she likes him back.”
“Yeah, I know, but…”
“But why bring it up now?”
“Well, I thought it wouldn’t be right to keep it a secret. Everyone’s always been helping me, so I wanted to be honest about it.”
Itsuki nodded at Father’s words.
“I understand about you two dating. But what about the person Motoyasu mentioned, the one you were close to in the first world?”
“Of course, I’ll keep looking for her.”
“And if you find her, will you switch to her?”
“Oh my? Will I be discarded then?”
My sister’s sister joined in on Itsuki’s question and asked Father. Father shook his head as if the very idea was insulting.
“Of course not! It’s not like I have to recreate what happened in the first world.”
“There’s some truth to that.”
Ren agreed. Come to think of it, in the first world, Ren liked Éclair and the assistant.
“That’s true. In Ren’s case, that’s certainly true.”
Ren seemed to get along well with Éclair and the assistant, but now they’re more distant, or rather, just comrades-in-arms. It’s not that they’re on bad terms or anything.
“Love is stupid! I don’t care!”
“Well, considering Ren’s age, it might be a bit early for that.”
Ren is 16. I was already chasing after pigs when I was in middle school, so I don’t think it’s too early. No, come to think of it, it feels like I’ve been doing that since I was aware of anything.
“Ren-san still hasn’t graduated from his chuunibyou phase.”
“And you’re one to talk…”
“You’re the one saying that?!”
“There’s a loop of justice enforcement here.”
Itsuki really has no right to say that.
“I-I’m fine, okay? I’m aware of it now! But I do want to experience love.”
“Buweh—”
“Ah, Rishia-san. Don’t be scared. I just want to slowly get closer to you, Rishia-san. It’s about love. I’m not thinking of anything impure like jumping into a physical relationship right away.”
“B-Bubu—”
Is the stalker pig still in shock?
“Well, I guess Ren is the farthest from romance among us?”
“What about Motoyasu!”
“Motoyasu-kun… he’s someone who’s practically made of love. He just hasn’t found the right person yet.”
“I’m devoted to Filo-tan!”
“You say that, but you’d settle for any Filolial. You completely lost yourself over Fitoria, didn’t you?”
Itsuki is saying something, but I don’t care! I’m the Love Hunter, devoted to Filo-tan!
“Guh…”
“Still, stop getting involved with random people you don’t know. If it’s one of those strange women hanging around reincarnators, everything could fall apart.”
“That’s exactly why we were talking about using the first world as a reference.”
“Damn it! Why are there only weird people around me?!”
Just then, Éclair came out after her bath.
“Hm? Oh, the heroes. What’s going on?”
“Eclair-san, what do you think about Ren?”
“What’s this all of a sudden? What I think about Amaki-dono? I think of him as a comrade I fight alongside…?”
“Ah… yeah. Ren’s got it tough.”
“At this point, how about raising one of Naofumi-san’s slaves or Filolials into your ideal woman?”
“The Hikaru Genji plan, huh?”
“Don’t make fun of me!”
Ren slammed the wall in anger.
